project.name: Forge Plugin
project.description: The Claude Code plugin for the Forge tracker: the forge CLI, the hooks that guard a session, and the skills that drive both. Repository: github.com/SidCorp-co/forge-plugin.

projectFacts.done-means: A change to any SKILL.md or references/ is done only when `npm run check` is green on the TRACKED tree and, for the two code-quality skills, `node tools/sync-skills.mjs --check` passes — the copy under packages/code-quality/claude-plugin/skills is generated from plugin/skills and never edited by hand.
projectFacts.test-commands: `npm test` runs plugin/test/*.test.mjs with node --test. `npm run check` is the full gate CI runs — lint, test, check:package, vi-text, vi-goldens, vendor, skill-paths, skill-boundaries, dup, sync:skills:check — and is what a verdict rests on. Two of those gates read the tracked tree via `git ls-files`, so stage new files before trusting a green.
projectFacts.build-commands: There is no compile step: the plugin is plain ESM and the runner reads it from disk. "Builds" means `npm ci` succeeds and `npm run lint` (eslint, including the repo's own code-quality rules) is clean. The standalone package is checked with `npm run check:package` and its pack shape with `npm --prefix packages/code-quality run pack:check`.
